notes: Built from the official complete source release with bundled FFmpeg decoders, ARM64 JIT and OpenGL ES. Runtime assets are packaged separately and extracted to a private versioned system directory. In-game saves use a per-game memory stick; PSP/SAVEDATA archives sync with RomM. The libretro patch reports serialization readiness after asynchronous boot and drains queued GPU frames while pausing.
